presets.name: Warm
presets.instruction: An original adult female voice speaking natural New Zealand English, with a warm relaxed tone, clear words and a gentle conversational pace. Use a New Zealand accent rather than American or Australian English. Do not imitate a real person.

presets.name: Clear
presets.instruction: An original adult male voice speaking natural New Zealand English, with a steady grounded tone, clear articulation and a calm helpful pace. Use a New Zealand accent rather than American or Australian English. Do not imitate a real person.

presets.name: Bright
presets.instruction: An original adult female voice speaking natural New Zealand English, with a bright expressive tone and an easy friendly pace. Use a New Zealand accent rather than American or Australian English. Do not imitate a real person.
